D/ [L] AVREL VERVS AVG [ARMENIACVS] ; R/ [TR P IIII IMP II COS II] SC

A Roman copper alloy coin: sestersius of Lucius Verus dating AD161-169. Reece period 8. RIC 1379 Sear no. 1451. Obverse: Diademed bust right. Obverse inscription: [L] AVREL VERVS AVG [ARMENIACVS]. Reverse: Mars advancing right carrying spear and trophy. Reverse inscription: [TR P IIII IMP II COS II] SC. Dimensions: diameter: 32.18mm; weight: 24.43g. Reference: Sear, D R. 1970.
